resources.string: Uses the compact controller layout with smaller on-screen buttons, so you can see more of the game. On-screen camera controls are disabled while it is on. Recommended when playing with a controller.\n\nApplies when a controller is connected as the game starts. If the HUD does not change straight away, restart the game.

Use the Controller HUD? It is a compact layout with smaller on-screen buttons, recommended for controllers. On-screen camera controls are disabled with it.\n\nYou can change this later: long-press the game icon and choose Controller settings.
